description: Update the relationship filter UI to support multi-select functionality when using 'in' or 'not_in' operators, regardless of whether the relationship field is configured as hasMany. Currently, only hasMany: true relationship fields allow multi-select, which prevents filtering by multiple values on hasMany: false relationship fields. This change should align relationship field behavior with how select fields already handle multi-select based on operator.
functional_requirements: Modify the relationship filter component to allow multi-select when the operator is 'in' or 'not_in', independent of the field's hasMany property
Ensure polymorphic relationship fields (relationTo with multiple collections) continue to not support 'in' or 'not_in' operators as they store structured objects
Update test utilities to properly handle array values in filter input scenarios
Add end-to-end tests that verify multi-value filtering works correctly on hasMany: false relationship fields
